name: Metrology & Inspection Station
description: Wafer inspection and measurement — CD measurement, defect density, film thickness, overlay error, yield calculation

operations.name: read_cd_measurement
operations.desc: Read critical dimension (CD) in nanometers (target: 7nm node)
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov al, 0x00
out 0x43, al
in al, 0x40
movzx eax, al
in al, 0x40
movzx ecx, al
shl ecx, 8
or eax, ecx
xor edx, edx
mov ecx, 16383
div ecx
add eax, 68
ret

operations.name: read_defect_density
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov al, 0x00
out 0x43, al
in al, 0x40
movzx eax, al
in al, 0x40
movzx ecx, al
shl ecx, 8
or eax, ecx
xor edx, edx
mov ecx, 4369
div ecx
add eax, 2
ret
operations.returns: Defects * 100 per cm² (e.g., 8 = 0.08/cm², range 2-17, alert if > 10)

operations.name: read_film_thickness
operations.desc: Read deposited film thickness in Angstroms (target varies by layer)
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov al, 0x00
out 0x43, al
in al, 0x40
movzx eax, al
in al, 0x40
movzx ecx, al
shl ecx, 8
or eax, ecx
xor edx, edx
mov ecx, 327
div ecx
add eax, 950
ret
operations.returns: Thickness in Angstroms (range 950-1150, target 1000 for gate oxide)

operations.name: read_overlay_error
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov al, 0x00
out 0x43, al
in al, 0x40
movzx eax, al
in al, 0x40
movzx ecx, al
shl ecx, 8
or eax, ecx
xor edx, edx
mov ecx, 16383
div ecx

ret
operations.returns: Overlay in 0.1nm units (e.g., 15 = 1.5nm, range 5-9, alert if > 20)

operations.asm:
BITS 32

out 0x43, al
in al, 0x40
